title: French Baked Fish with Smoky Flavor
description: A simple and flavorful fish dish baked in a papillote with smoky spices and herbs.

ingredients.name: fish fillet (any white fish)
ingredients.notes: any white fish like cod, tilapia, or mahi-mahi

instructions: Season the fish fillet with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, mix minced garlic, smoked paprika, and chopped parsley.
Place the fish fillet on the center of the parchment paper.
Drizzle olive oil over the fish, then sprinkle the garlic-paprika mixture.
Place the halved tomatoes around the fish.
Fold the parchment paper over the fish, creating a papillote.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
